import json, os, re, urllib.request, urllib.error
raw = os.environ["BLAND_API_KEY"].strip()
if raw.startswith("{"):
    p = json.loads(raw); raw = next((p[k] for k in ("api_key", "key", "value") if p.get(k)), raw)
CID = "fe42be63-d08d-4be9-b04d-a08efe54de4c"
mask = lambda s: re.sub(r"\d{5,}", lambda m: "***" + m.group(0)[-4:], str(s))
req = urllib.request.Request("https://api.bland.ai/v1/sms/conversations/" + CID, headers={"Authorization": raw, "Content-Type": "application/json", "User-Agent": "mybcat-cli"})
print("=== ANKIT RETEST THREAD %s ===" % CID[-6:])
try:
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=60) as r:
        detail = json.loads(r.read().decode() or "{}")
    d = detail.get("data") if isinstance(detail.get("data"), dict) else detail
    print("DETAIL HTTP 200 node=%s version=%s active=%s" % (d.get("current_node_id"), d.get("curr_pathway_version"), d.get("is_active")))
    msgs = d.get("messages") or []
    print("MESSAGES: %d" % len(msgs))
    for m in msgs:
        if not isinstance(m, dict):
            continue
        ts = str(m.get("created_at", ""))[:19]
        print("  [%s] %s (%s): %s" % (ts, m.get("sender", "?"), m.get("status", "?"), mask(str(m.get("message", ""))[:500])))
    v = d.get("variables") or {}
    keep = {k: v.get(k) for k in ("appt_count", "store", "today", "timezone") if k in v}
    print("VARS: %s" % mask(json.dumps(keep)))
except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
    print("DETAIL HTTP %s %s" % (e.code, e.read().decode(errors="replace")[:200]))
print("THREAD_DONE")
PY
